messages:
sasha (frontend): Heads-up — we need to roll back svc-frontend in prod to rev 3, user-facing errors after the last deploy. Requesting temporary elevated access (~20-30m) to run the rollback and check logs. Can someone approve JIT cluster-admin or a namespaced elevated role?

sasha (frontend): rollback command I plan to run:
```
kubectl --context=prod -n frontend rollout undo deploy/svc-frontend --to-revision=3
```

anya (security): quick Qs — what's the justification and exact time window? prefer least-privilege (namespace role) over cluster-admin if possible. also we need an audit entry and session recording. make sure to flag any logs with PII before sharing.

mike (oncall): I can approve a 30m JIT. please open an access ticket in the portal so it gets tracked (tag:privileged-access). Approve only if you run from bastion and paste the session link after.

sasha (frontend): opening ticket now — will tag and include justification: "rollback svc-frontend after canary failure; revert to stable rev 3; brief verification of logs; no DB writes". ETA to run: in ~5m if approved.

jordan (platform): if you want, I can do the rollback and hand back immediately — less blast radius. But if you need to inspect pod logs yourself, JIT is fine.

anya (security): if jordan runs it, we still need the ticket and the log recording. Also redact any user identifiers before posting logs here. See org doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/log-redaction (quick checklist).

access-bot: JIT request created: AR-2026 by sasha. Scope: kube-ns:frontend elevated role (admin-ish) — expires 30m after activation. Pending manual approval from oncall.

mike (oncall): approved. activating now. Please confirm when done and paste session link + any roll-forward plan if rollback has side effects. :thumbsup:

access-bot: AR-2026 activated for sasha (expires 2026-05-14T15:12:58Z). Audit entry: https://redwood.internal/audit/AR-2026

sasha (frontend): Running the rollback now, will check pod readiness and tail logs. Will redact before sharing.

sasha (frontend): rollback done, pods coming up, all healthchecks passing. Session recording: https://redwood.internal/sessions/rec-88421 (contains full terminal output). I pulled logs and sanitized PII per checklist; pasted redacted excerpt below.

sasha (frontend): (redacted log snippet)
`[INFO] 15:03:12 request_id=*** user_id=*** status=200 svc=frontend`

mike (oncall): thanks — marking AR-2026 closed. leave a short postmortem in #incidents if you have time.

anya (security): thanks all. reminder: keep tickets attached to the incident and set retention per policy.

jordan (platform): nice work. if any follow-up configs needed for rollout strategy, ping me.

sasha (frontend): closing thread — will add notes to the incident doc. :white_check_mark:
